text: Debugging is an essential skill for every programmer. When your code does not work as expected, the first step is identifying bugs by carefully reading error messages and observing the program's behaviour. Fortunately, many debugging tools can help you find problems quickly, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution. However, tools alone are not enough. You should follow a systematic approach: reproduce the bug, isolate the cause, and test your fix. Good logging is also extremely valuable. By adding log statements to your code, you can track what happens while the program runs and spot where things go wrong. With patience and practice, debugging becomes much easier.
